LanguageData.DMS_MechCapsule_VaultKennel.label: mothballed bullhound
LanguageData.DMS_MechCapsule_VaultKennel.description: A bullhound garrison automatroid in hibernation mode, clamped into its charging kennel. It was left on watch when the installation was sealed, and its alarm circuit is still live. A mechanitor can attempt to hack and control it.
